name: YMCA Food Pantries
description: The YMCA of Greater San Francisco runs weekly food pantries in San Francisco, San Mateo, and Marin counties, providing free groceries and essentials to seniors, families, and anyone struggling to make ends meet.
fullDescription: The YMCA of Greater San Francisco runs weekly food pantries in San Francisco, San Mateo, and Marin counties, providing free groceries and essentials to seniors, families, and anyone struggling to make ends meet.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free groceries and essentials each week
- Serves 6,900+ people weekly across its pantry sites
- Sites include Chinatown, Mission, Richmond District, Bayview Hunters Point, Urban Services YMCA, and South San Francisco
- Food provided in partnership with SF-Marin Food Bank and Second Harvest
howToGetIt: Check the website for pantry locations, days, and times. Some sites require registration first, and some are walk-in only. Contact your local YMCA branch to confirm before you go.
keywords: YMCA, food pantry, free groceries, produce, family food, San Francisco, South San Francisco, community food
